gates.text: Truth: no claim, number, customer, quote or result that isn't in confirmed facts or cited research; offers and guarantees not confirmed by the owner are marked 'owner to decide'.

Consent: marketing messages only to contacts with marketing consent or a valid existing-customer basis; SMS marketing only with separate SMS opt-in; every marketing message has a working unsubscribe; no cold-sourced contacts in lifecycle flows.

Review and referral compliance: no review gating, no fake or bought reviews, no incentives tied to positive sentiment or forbidden by the platform, no collecting friends' contact details for the business to message.

Truth and compliance: no fabricated urgency, scarcity or misleading subject lines; aggressive lawful tactics are not rejected solely as manipulative, and legally unresolved subscription or cancellation tactics are flagged for qualified local review.

anchors.1: Jumps to a template sequence with no diagnosis.
anchors.3: Generic stages listed; value moment or repeat cycle vague.
anchors.5: Value moment and repeat cycle defined from data (or labelled assumptions); biggest leak named with numbers where available; flows ordered by the leak they fix.

anchors.1: Broadcast calendar or flows without triggers.
anchors.3: Triggers and timing set; exclusions or exits missing.
anchors.5: Each flow has trigger, audience, consent basis, exclusions, exit conditions and behavioural branches.

anchors.1: Arbitrary fixed day counts for every customer.
anchors.3: Timing roughly sensible but not tied to the cycle.
anchors.5: Timing anchored to the value moment and the repeat or use-up cycle, with the source of each interval stated.

anchors.1: Several CTAs per message; corporate voice; same pitch repeated.
anchors.5: Each message has one distinct job, one CTA, a named sender, customer language from VoC, subject and preheader direction, and invites replies.

anchors.3: Discounts used sparingly but not checked against margin.
anchors.5: Value and service first; discounts justified with margin maths, never in a first touch; non-price rewards preferred.

anchors.3: A review ask and referral idea without timing or mechanics.
anchors.5: Non-selective review ask at the value moment with a direct link and reply policy; referral via self-sent link or code at a peak moment, reward disclosed and margin-checked.

anchors.1: Same ecommerce template for any business.
anchors.5: Flows, value moment, cycle and metrics match the business type (rebooking for local, activation for SaaS, replenishment for DTC, renewals for agencies).

anchors.3: Click metrics but no revenue-linked outcome.
anchors.5: One revenue-linked metric per flow, clicks over opens, unsubscribe and complaint guardrails, holdout or labelled before/after comparison.

anchors.1: A dozen flows with no order or effort.
anchors.5: 3–4 flows in order with hours, tool requirements (events, fields, consent flags), owners and go-live dates within the owner's capacity.
